allow: Bash(docker compose exec -T web bundle exec rspec *)
Bash(docker compose exec -T web bin/rails routes *)
Bash(docker compose exec -T web bin/rails db:migrate)

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+(-f|--force)|git\s+reset\s+--hard|DROP\s+TABLE' && { echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
